title: Name-Tithe Reader
text: Name-Tithe Reader reads old names from blank paper until one of them answers from inside the expedition. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The ledger remembers people who never existed.

defeatReward.text: Name-Tithe Reader is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
